rule: Expected observations are literal review of each plan under vm/SPEC.md, written before any VM run (D7); golden rows reuse vm/golden images with invocations the goldens do not freeze.

runs.name: deep-250k
runs.basis: U32.is_eq(depth(250000n), 250000): 250,000 pending U32.add frames, then True{} (Bool is type 2)

runs.name: frames-400k
runs.basis: SPEC section 6: 12 words per pending level; 400,000 levels need 19.2 MB of the 16 MiB region

runs.name: quantum-action
runs.basis: entries: main 1, spin(65531n) 65,532, IO.print 1, the Action twice (the second, #65,536, prints and spends the quantum), the terminal 1 = 65,537

runs.name: quantum-action-fuel-short
runs.basis: the print is entry 65,536; the terminal continuation has no fuel

runs.name: ill-typed
runs.basis: coerce: none -> none instantiates a U32 7 at Flag; the Case inspects immediate tag 7 of a 2-constructor type

runs.name: unsupported-foreign
runs.basis: IO.args (foreign 0) has no vm-core effect; refused before any entry, although main never reaches it

runs.name: render-list
runs.basis: build(100000n, Stop{}) pushes On{} 100,000 times by tail calls; 200,001 visits

runs.name: display-visits
runs.basis: SPEC section 8: 600,000 Push cells need 1,200,001 visits, above 1,048,576 (Exhausted kind 2 display)

runs.name: display-text
runs.basis: SPEC section 8: 9,000 cells named by 2,000 bytes are 18 MB of tree text, above 16 MiB, in 18,001 visits

runs.name: render-nat
runs.basis: a Nat word renders as its logical view

runs.name: pred-structured
runs.basis: ordinal 1 is Succ, which has a field

runs.name: ordinal-syntax
runs.basis: ordinals are decimal, checked before the export

runs.name: print-fuel-exact
runs.basis: entries: main, IO.print, the Action (erased R), the Action with the terminal (prints), the terminal = 5

runs.name: bind-fuel-exact
runs.basis: entries: main, IO.print, IO.bind, C1, C2, Action_a twice (prints a), C3, k1, IO.pure, IO.bind, C1', C2', P1, P2, C3', k2, IO.print, Action_b twice (prints b), terminal = 21

limited.name: deep-heap-1mib
limited.basis: about 32,000 Activations of 32 bytes fill 1 MiB
